SELECT /* isry.itgcm.casemng.caseunity.SrvcGrPvsnMapper.selectGrExcnProgramList(프로그램목록조회) */ DISTINCT T1.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , T1.PROGRM_NO AS PROGRM_NO -- 프로그램번호 , T1.PROGRM_TTL_NM AS PROGRM_TTL_NM -- 프로그램제목명 , T1.PROGRM_DSCRP_CN AS PROGRM_DSCRP_CN -- 프로그램설명내용 , T1.PROGRM_DGSTFN_CN AS PROGRM_DGSTFN_CN -- 프로그램만족도내용 , T1.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD AS EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD -- 교육프로그램구분코드 , T1.PROGRM_CN AS PROGRM_CN -- 프로그램내용 , T1.PROGRM_BGNG_YMD AS PROGRM_BGNG_YMD -- 프로그램시작일자 , T1.PROGRM_END_YMD AS PROGRM_END_YMD -- 프로그램종료일자 , T1.PROGRM_SUM_HR AS PROGRM_SUM_HR -- 프로그램합계시간 , T1.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드 , T1.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드 , T1.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드 , T1.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세구분코드 , T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN -- 삭제여부 , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시
, '' AS SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호
, T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호
FROM SDA300 T1 /* 자원프로그램 */
WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEL_YN(+) != 'Y'
, SEB520 T2 /* 자원프로그램제공대상자 */ , SEB510 T3 /* 서비스제공대상자 */ WHERE T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND T1.RESRCE_NO = T2.RESRCE_NO AND T1.PROGRM_NO = T2.PROGRM_NO AND T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND T2.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T3.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T3.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T3.DEL_YN != 'Y'
AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} ORDER BY T1.RESRCE_NO, T1.PROGRM_NO

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.casemng.caseunity.SrvcGrPvsnMapper.selectExcnCaseTrprList(사례대상자목록조회) */ T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명 , T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , T1.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T1.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T2.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD -- 사례시작일자 , T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자 , T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태구분코드 , T5.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태유형구분코드 , T3.CASE_PIC_NO AS CASE_PIC_NO -- 사례담당자번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T6.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CASE_PIC_NM -- 사례담당자명 , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 , T7.INST_NM AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 , T4.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 , T4.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , T4.SRVC_PVSN_YN AS SRVC_PVSN_YN -- 서비스제공여부 , T1.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T1.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO||T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_NO_ODRNO , T8.DDLN_CRTR_YMD , T8.INST_NO , T8.DDLN_YM , T8.DDLN_YN , T8.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD FROM SEA200 T1 , SEB100 T2 , SEB150 T3 , SEB510 T4 , SAC100 T5 , SCA100 T6 , SAA000 T7 , (SELECT CASE WHEN A.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = '00' THEN TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM')),'YYYYMMDD') WHEN A.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = '99' THEN TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(A.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM'), 1)),'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(A.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM'), 1), 'YYYYMM') || A.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD END AS DDLN_CRTR_YMD /* 마감기준년월 */ , A.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , A.DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM /* 마감년월 */ , A.DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN /* 마감여부 */ , A.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드 */ FROM SEC330 A /* 사례관리마감 */ WHERE A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.DDLN_YM = ( SELECT MAX(DDLN_YM) FROM SEC330 WHERE INST_NO = A.INST_NO AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD ) AND A.DDLN_YN = 'Y' ) T8 WHERE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T4.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T4.SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T4.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' = T5.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD= T5.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND T3.CASE_PIC_NO = T6.ENFSN_NO(+) AND T3.PIC_INST_NO = T7.INST_NO(+) AND T6.OGDP_INST_NO = T8.INST_NO(+) ORDER BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO DESC

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.casemng.caseunity.SrvcGrPvsnMapper.selectBizNoExcnCaseTrprList(서비스집단제공 서비스실행사업번호 기준 사례대상자 목록조회) */ DISTINCT T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명 , T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , T1.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T1.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T2.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD -- 사례시작일자 , T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자 , T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태구분코드 , (SELECT UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD) AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태유형구분코드 , T3.CASE_PIC_NO AS CASE_PIC_NO -- 사례담당자번호 , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.CASE_PIC_NO) AS CASE_PIC_NM -- 사례담당자명 , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = T3.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 , #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO -- 서비스실행사업번호
, '' AS RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호
, T4.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호
FROM SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ , SEB100 T2 /* 사례기본 */ , SEB150 T3 /* 사례담당자 */ , SEB510 T4 /* 서비스제공대상자 */ , SEB500 T5 /* 서비스제공 */ , SDA100 T6 /* 자원기본 */ WHERE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T4.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T4.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T5.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T4.RESRCE_NO = T5.RESRCE_NO AND T4.RESRCE_NO = T6.RESRCE_NO AND T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN ('01','02','03','05','12') AND #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} = ( SELECT CASE WHEN X.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_CHC_PSBLTY_YN = 'Y' THEN T5.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO ELSE T6.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO END FROM ( SELECT Y.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_CHC_PSBLTY_YN FROM SAC100 Y WHERE Y.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND Y.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} ) X )
AND T4.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO}
AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T4.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND T5.DEL_YN != 'Y' ORDER BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO DESC

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.casemng.caseunity.SrvcGrPvsnMapper.selectBizNoCaseTrprList(서비스실행사업번호 기준 사례대상자 목록조회) */ DISTINCT T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , T1.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명 , T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , T1.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T2.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD -- 사례시작일자 , T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자 , T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태구분코드 , (SELECT UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD) AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태유형구분코드
, T3.CASE_PIC_NO AS CASE_PIC_NO -- 사례담당자번호 , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.CASE_PIC_NO) AS CASE_PIC_NM -- 사례담당자명 , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = T3.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 , T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO -- 서비스실행사업번호 FROM SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ , SEB100 T2 /* 사례기본 */ , SEB150 T3 /* 사례담당자 */ , SEB120 T4 /* 서비스사업대상자 */ WHERE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' /*주담당자기준*/ AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T4.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T4.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} AND T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN ('01','02','03','05','12') AND T3.PIC_INST_NO = #{INST_NO} ORDER BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.SRVC_PVSN_NO , (SELECT SRVC_PVSN_TTL_NM FROM SEB500 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO) AS SRVC_PVSN_TTL_NM , A.RESRCE_NO , (SELECT PVSN_RESRCE_NM FROM SDA100 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO) AS RESRCE_NM , B.BIZ_YR , B.BIZ_CL_SE_CD , B.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO , B.SRVC_BIZ_NM , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NM , C.BIZ_BGNG_YMD , C.BIZ_END_YMD , C.BGT_EXCN_AMT , A.GR_TRGT_SRVC_YN FROM SEB540 A, SDA430 B, SDA440 C WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO = B.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO AND A.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO = C.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO AND A.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO = C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO AND A.SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO}
